notes.title: What's Next for The Vanished Soul? January Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As we shared a development update for December, I wanted to share some news in the January update as well. The New Year started off pretty well, but time is already flying by like crazy! I wish I had more free time to work on the game, but I think I’m still managing to make steady progress.

DEVELOPMENT NEWS:

As mentioned above, progress is definitely happening. I’ve been adding new features to the game and, at the same time, working on polishing some of the existing features in the game and the demo that many of you had the chance to play.

In the December update, I shared the news about the dynamic jump scare system, and I’m excited to say this has been expanded. For the upcoming demo, there will be at least 20 different dynamic jump scares, ensuring that each playthrough offers a unique experience with varying outcomes.

Building on this, I’ve also added a system where your choices truly matter! That’s right—there will be multiple outcomes for the game. Certain actions will have smaller impacts, altering tasks, while others might significantly influence the game’s ending. This system will feature different texts, items, and player behaviors depending on your decisions. In the next demo update, you’ll get a glimpse of this system on a smaller scale, but it will give you an idea of where it’s headed.

Additionally, I want to pay tribute to my first created and published game, Roll the Ball, by including a mini-game inspired by it, which you can play while in your apartment.

The scope for the next demo update is already set, but there’s still a lot of work to be done to polish it and get it ready for release. I’m experimenting with different puzzles and trying to introduce innovative elements, but game development takes time. My goal is to deliver a game that’s as polished as possible, especially considering I’m a solo developer.

Here are a couple of the latest images from the game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220003/23f27de01f91a022efce4fdf383ba14fdca3a24f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220003/cd60a2ac4f3b38a019a9bdeb9aa7fe3915826e96.jpg

WHAT'S NEXT?

The plan to participate in the February edition of Steam Next Fest is still in place, but I’m not entirely sure if the game will be ready in time. I don’t want to stress myself out or risk burning out, so I’ll continue working at my usual pace. By mid-February, I’ll evaluate the progress and decide whether I have something I’m genuinely satisfied with or if it would make more sense to postpone participation until the June edition of Steam Next Fest.

Once again, a big thank you to everyone! I’ll make sure to post updates at least once a month to keep you all informed about what’s happening behind the scenes.

For more updates, feel free to join our Discord server.

notes.title: What’s Next for The Vanished Soul? December Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while since the last update, so I wanted to share some news about the state of development and what’s coming next.

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who tried the demo! I’m thrilled that the demo has received 100% positive reviews! This is incredibly motivating and inspires me to deliver the best game possible.

The number of wishlists is also steadily growing and has already far surpassed my previous published game, which shows that the game is definitely heading in the right direction! THANK YOU ONCE AGAIN!

DEVELOPMENT NEWS:

Development is progressing really well! Certain parts of the game, like the menu and options, have been completely revamped to provide a higher-quality experience. The game’s story has been expanded, which will hopefully make it more interesting and engaging. A lot of new areas are being added to the game to align with the story—though I won’t spoil anything at this stage.

I’m also thrilled to share that the first implementation of the dynamic jump scare system is now in the game! I’m really excited about this feature!

In addition to the revamped menu system, a few more options will be added to enhance the gameplay experience. I’m also working hard to optimize the game as much as possible.

I’m planning to include fully voiced dialogue in two languages: English and Bosnian. There are already some discussions underway, but let’s see how things develop on this front.

Here are a couple of the latest images from the game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220003/1bd37a4e7d0b56be6e43a7f5f58b8693da25357b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220003/793aee162431541f89dcaaf25e6bcbea74f8d905.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220003/3642fccdc2cb3602bdabce2143ea489c9fd1dd7e.jpg


WHAT’S NEXT?

I am excited to announce that I am planning to participate in the Steam Next Fest, which will begin on the 24th of February. For this occasion, the current demo version will be revamped to provide a much better experience for everyone! The flow of the new demo will also be adjusted, primarily to ensure that players who have already played the old demo won’t have to go through all the same sections again.

The gameplay time is expected to be longer than in the previous demo, offering a clearer picture of what the game is about and what you can expect in the full release. As for the full game, the release date is still planned for some point in 2025, most likely in Q4. More details on the Steam Next Fest and the new demo content will be shared next year.

Once again, many thanks to everyone! I will ensure that announcements are made at least once a month so that everyone stays in the loop about what’s happening behind the scenes.

For more updates, feel free to join our Discord server.

notes.title: A big thank you and a small update for the demo is pushed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, a huge thank you for all the support so far! It has been truly incredible, and I appreciate it immensely! The best way I can return the favor is by making the game even better, especially for the full release, and I promise that will happen. The demo build will receive a few updates in the coming days, and after that, I’ll be shifting my focus to the full release, which will include many exciting new features, jump scares, locations, and story elements.

If you want to stay up to date, I recommend joining the Discord community, which is already growing. I will also post regular updates here whenever new content is added to the game.

JOIN DISCORD

Additionally, I want to let you know that I pushed a small update to the demo. If you haven’t adjusted any graphic options, you’ve been playing the game with Screen Space Global Illumination, which is a bit unfortunate because the game looks its best with Lumen. This has now been fixed, and the default option is set to Lumen. I highly recommend replaying the demo with Lumen enabled for the best experience. On top of that, I’ve fixed a few lighting, audio, and writing issues.

Again, I can’t thank you all enough!

Happy gaming!
Belmin
